dynamics_identity_check.interpretation: Adding flow instrumentation did not alter any previously measured replication dynamics.

interpretation: The previously observed rebound split is realized in actual recruitment flow, not merely in an instantaneous hazard diagnostic.
Known rebound worlds generated substantial excess recruitment during the disruption period and continued to generate excess recruitment after disruption ended.
Known suppressed worlds generated less recruitment than their paired baselines on average, especially after intervention removal.
Because the endpoint rebound labels were known before these flow measurements were generated, these differences are mechanistic hypotheses rather than independent confirmation.
next_requirement: Confirm on fresh seeds that excess replacement flow, especially after disruption removal, discriminates rebound from durable suppression.
